def candidate(turn_event_id, seed_state, *, kappa=p7mod.KAPPA, signal_overrides=None, ambiguity_band=None):
    canonical=fill_jspace(turn_event_id,seed_state,kappa=kappa,signal_overrides=signal_overrides)
    if ambiguity_band is None: return canonical
    band=float(ambiguity_band)
    if not math.isfinite(band) or band < 0.0: raise ValueError('invalid ambiguity_band')
    best=max(c.signal for c in canonical.candidates)
    eligible=tuple(c for c in canonical.candidates if c.signal >= best-band)
    if not eligible: raise ValueError('no eligible candidate')
    winner=max(eligible,key=lambda c:c.proposal_score)
    return JSpace(turn_event_id=canonical.turn_event_id,candidates=canonical.candidates,winner_cell_id=winner.cell_id,broadcast_value=winner.proposal_score)
